purpose: Development repair of the existing two-state positive-gain model, before any new parameter fit. This is not a fresh scientific confirmation.
training_split: Original 40 Native VGR episodes marked train in v1_cases; original source and environment groups unchanged. No eval episodes or House03 data are used in fitting.
development_split: Original 8 Native VGR episodes marked dev in v1_cases; used once for fixed-model diagnostics, not hyperparameter selection.
model: y_e = m_{s_e} g_e + d_e + epsilon_e; common positive-truncated Gaussian envelope g_e~N(g0,vg), d_e covariance vd*exp(-abs(t_i-t_j)/tau), epsilon_e iid N(0,R). The m template uses the existing causal sensor and event-window operator.
observations: Use actual event times and every observed continuous gas value, including all-zero episodes. No threshold-based deletion, invented zero censoring, or saturation model. This working likelihood may be misspecified at zero and must be reported as such.
objective: Maximize equal-environment mean of equal-episode mean predictive log density: for each environment average log p(y_e|true source,theta)/N_e, then average equally over the three training environments. The gain is analytically integrated and truncated at g>=0.

optimizer.selection: Lowest train-only objective among all four fixed starts. A failed start is retained in the audit. No additional starts or bounds after viewing output.

fixed_dev_screen_before_planner: On the 8 original dev paths, new mean true-source posterior NLL must be lower than both old AOD and the uniform-support NLL, and new mean truth rank must be lower than old AOD. Otherwise stop before building or running a new planner. Report every case and all boundary parameters regardless of result.
future_closed_loop_limit_if_screen_passe: At most the existing three OPEN cases x two development arms (new calibration with original planner; same calibration with model-consistent planner). Reuse cached Native only if the full runtime contract matches. No new plume, network, or candidate bank. These cases cannot become fresh confirmation.
